about: The raw copies of answers each Small Claims demo file still names (reads, and the builder's own writes of the analysis copy), counted on 6 Nov 2026 after the overview moved onto the record. Checked by test:screens-read-record: a count may only go down, and when it does the entry is lowered. Each reason names the sweep entries (A1-A41 of 6 Nov) that explain it; moving a screen onto the record is the work these numbers track.

entries.reason: sweep A3, A22, A25, A26, A28, A37: the builder writes the analysis copy (intakeData, intakeFacts, intakeAnswers, the title), seeds the chat and the whole form from saved copies, and shows the results from React state
sweep A22-A25, A27: the chat keeps its own answer list (earlierAnswers) and facts, sends them to the turn and the depth questions, and words its cards from them
sweep A30-A32: the whole form reads its own section copy for its start values and the story reader's offers
sweep A29: the review draws its boxes from each section's copy; F1 shows the record's answer over a box that differs (reviewBoxState)
sweep A18, A19: the overview's story and side come from the analysis copy; its amount, parties and outcome read the record since 6 Nov (A17)
sweep A11: the case layout reads the side from the analysis copy and facts for cases with no situation answer
sweep A13, A14: the case page offers dates from the saved chat answers and reads the person's words from the analysis copy
sweep A4, A5: the case file page's story and 'What you want' come from the analysis copy
sweep A14: the Forms tab reads the person's words from the analysis copy

sweep A2: the dashboard selects columns of the analysis copy and rebuilds a partial master_result; since 9 Nov (Chrome check of #545) it reads the saved case title (master_result->>caseTitle, written by factRecord.ts applyFactWrites) instead of master_result->intakeData->otherParty
sweep A29, A30: the review's entries are drawn from each section's copy, and the analysis input reads the chat's facts

sweep A7-A11, A31: readCaseRecord reads the analysis copy and the saved chat answers (amount, city, story, side, dates); storedIntakeValues still reads the copies for boxes with no fact, and since 6 Nov takes amount, what you want and urgent from the record (F1 root cause)
sweep A12, A15: the step's story words come from the analysis copy
